$comment: Repo-owned fixture catalog for the f141baad AC2 contract test (docs-and-config-contract.test.ts). It mirrors the shape of the machine-global agent-mcp catalog rows (the `agents.data` JSON that agent_create persists) for agents whose shell MCP server is gated by the per-repo mcp-shell policy. MCP_SHELL_SEC_CONFIG_FILE is recorded REPO-RELATIVE; the test resolves it against the repo root, so the assertion that the canonical tools/mcp-shell/security.yaml exists (and that no entry points at the removed scripts/mcp-shell-security.yaml) runs unconditionally in CI even when no machine-global catalog is present. Keep this path in sync with tools/mcp-shell/security.yaml; a rename/move must update this seed or AC2 goes red.
